skills.name: agent_status
skills.description: Check operational status of agents (idle/busy/down/disabled). No args = all agents. With agent name = single agent.

skills.name: alm_complete
skills.description: Mark your own in_progress proposal as done (awaiting Ghost confirmation to close).

skills.name: alm_create_proposal
skills.description: Create an ALM work proposal/ticket. Accepts quoted title+description or <title> || <description>.

skills.name: alm_self_approve
skills.description: Self-approve your own proposal and set it to in_progress. Creates a Vortex checkpoint. No Ghost approval needed.

skills.name: alm_vortex
skills.description: Create a named Vortex (time machine) checkpoint. Call before making any file changes.

skills.name: browse
skills.description: Fetch a URL with headless Chromium. Returns page text. Needs a full URL — use search for questions.

skills.name: build_tool
skills.description: Scaffold a new tool from template. Types: script, skill, widget, cron, shell. Creates files + DB record.

skills.name: check_models
skills.description: List locally installed Ollama models with sizes. Use "new" to check Ollama registry for trending models. Use "update <model>" to pull latest.

skills.name: claude_code
skills.description: Run a prompt through the Claude Code CLI (non-interactive). Best for code generation, review, and analysis tasks.

skills.name: deep_dive
skills.description: Start a deep research investigation. 5+ sources, cross-validation, gap analysis.

skills.name: file_read
skills.description: Read a file from a sandpit. Format: agent/filename.txt

skills.name: file_write
skills.description: Write content to your sandpit.

skills.name: fs_patch
skills.description: Replace an exact string in a file (first occurrence). Safe targeted edit without full rewrite.

skills.name: fs_patch_lines
skills.description: Replace a line range in a file by line numbers. PREFERRED over fs_patch — no exact-match fragility. Read with fs_readonly lines first to get line numbers, then replace that range.

skills.name: fs_readonly
skills.description: Read-only filesystem helper for workspace discovery (ls/find/read/head/tail/lines).

skills.name: fs_verify
skills.description: Syntax-check a Python or JavaScript file after patching. ALWAYS run this after every fs_patch or fs_patch_lines call.

skills.name: fs_write
skills.description: Write (overwrite) any file within the swarm repo. Creates parent dirs as needed.

skills.name: housekeeping
skills.description: Run the Librarian housekeeping cycle: archive old memories, remove duplicates, trigger agent play time.

skills.name: knowledge_search
skills.description: Search the consultant knowledge library (SAP HCM, ABAP, emails, PDFs, SAP notes).

skills.name: knowledge_write
skills.description: Write a new entry to the shared swarm knowledge base. Governed: only from completed proposal context or ghost.

skills.name: list
skills.description: List all available skills.

skills.name: lmstudio
skills.description: Chat with whatever model is currently loaded in LM Studio (port 1234, OpenAI-compat API).

skills.name: memory_search
skills.description: Search the swarm memory pools. Returns top matches.

skills.name: ollama_web_fetch
skills.description: Fetch and return full page content from a URL via Ollama cloud API (requires OLLAMA_API_KEY).

skills.name: ollama_web_search
skills.description: Web search via Ollama cloud API (requires OLLAMA_API_KEY). Returns title, URL, and snippet per result.

skills.name: picoclaw
skills.description: Send a message to a PicoClaw agent (has exec, web_fetch, web_search, subagent, cron tools built in). Runs picoclaw agent -m.

skills.name: proposals
skills.description: Check sandpits/shared/proposals/ for new agent proposals and notify Ghost.

skills.name: remind
skills.description: Send Ghost an immediate plain-text reminder email.

skills.name: research
skills.description: Start a research session on a topic. Searches, analyses, and archives findings. Default depth: standard.

skills.name: research_resume
skills.description: Resume a paused research session.

skills.name: research_status
skills.description: Check the status and summary of a research session.

skills.name: schedule
skills.description: Create a scheduled task. Same syntax as SCHEDULE command.

skills.name: search
skills.description: DuckDuckGo web search. Returns top snippets.

skills.name: search_landscape
skills.description: Search the living system landscape JSON index (files, blueprints, tables, agents, skills).

skills.name: shell
skills.description: Run a whitelisted shell command. Output returned and emailed to Ghost.

skills.name: swarm_knowledge_search
skills.description: Search the shared swarm knowledge base (lessons, decisions, facts, patterns, warnings).

skills.name: system_index
skills.description: Generate or query the system index (modules, blueprints, tables, agents, skills). No args = regenerate. With args = search the index.

skills.name: tasker_history
skills.description: Show recent task execution history — what ran, when, and the result.

skills.name: tasker_list
skills.description: List all scheduled tasks and registered Python tasks with their schedules and status.

skills.name: tasker_run
skills.description: Run a registered Python task immediately. Use tasker_list to see available tasks.

skills.name: ticket_create
skills.description: Create an internal ticket/proposal. Format: <title> || <description>

skills.name: tool_list
skills.description: List tool builds. Optionally filter by agent name.

skills.name: tool_status
skills.description: Check the status of a tool build (scaffolded/building/testing/passed/failed/registered).

skills.name: tool_test
skills.description: Run tests for a tool build. Discovers pytest test file or runs --dry-run.

skills.name: tool_validate
skills.description: Run syntax validation on a tool build (Python AST, node --check, bash -n).

skills.name: ui_css_edit_checklist
skills.description: Show the global checklist for correct UI/CSS edit workflow (selectors, patching, verification).

skills.name: update_landscape
skills.description: Regenerate the system landscape index (MD + JSON). Governed: requires trust_level 2.
